schemes.description: Central government direct income support scheme for landholding farmer families across India, launched in February 2019 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. Provides financial assistance to help meet input costs and support household needs.
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 each, transferred directly via Direct Benefit Transfer into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the farmer family. The scheme has been extended through 2030-31.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Available to all landholding farmer families across India including Maharashtra, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat, regardless of crop grown, for marginal, small, medium and large farmers, subject to income tax exclusion criteria.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership record, Bank account details
schemes.source: Confirmed via live search 2026-08-08: pib.gov.in and pmkisan.gov.in

schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield losses from natural calamities, pests and diseases, covering Kharif, Rabi and horticultural crops.
schemes.benefits: Farmers pay a low premium of 2% of sum insured for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops; the government subsidizes the remaining actuarial premium.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Crop insurance available to farmers growing notified Kharif and Rabi crops including Cotton, Wheat, Rice and Sugarcane, for marginal, small and all other farmer categories.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record or tenancy agreement, Bank account details, Sowing declaration

schemes.description: Provides farmers with timely, affordable short-term credit for crop production and allied activities such as animal husbandry, dairy and fisheries.
schemes.benefits: Short-term crop loans up to Rs 5 lakh available at a concessional 7% per annum interest, subject to government interest subvention.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Credit and loan support for all farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees and share-croppers.
schemes.required_documents: Application form, Passport-size photographs, Land holding proof, Cropping pattern details

schemes.description: Provides farmers with soil health cards containing crop-wise nutrient and fertilizer recommendations based on lab-tested soil samples.
schemes.benefits: Free soil testing and a personalized soil health card with fertilizer and nutrient recommendations.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Soil testing and fertilizer recommendation support available to all farmers.
schemes.required_documents: Land record, Aadhaar Card

schemes.description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis into a unified online market.
schemes.benefits: Access to online, transparent price discovery across integrated mandis; reduced transaction costs.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Online agricultural marketing and price discovery platform for farmers.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Registration at a participating mandi

schemes.description: Promotes farm mechanization by improving farmers' access to agricultural machinery and equipment.
schemes.benefits: Subsidy support for purchase of agricultural machinery and equipment.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Farm mechanization and equipment subsidy support.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details, Machinery quotation

schemes.scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
schemes.description: Financial, technical and business support for micro food processing enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of Rs 10 lakh per unit.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Food processing, micro enterprises, capital subsidy, value addition.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank account details, Project Report

schemes.description: Aims to enhance physical access of water on farm and expand cultivable area under assured irrigation.
schemes.benefits: Subsidies for micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) and water conservation structures.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Irrigation, water conservation, drip irrigation, sprinkler.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details

schemes.scheme_name: Namo Shetkari Maha Sanman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.description: Maharashtra state scheme providing additional financial assistance to PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
schemes.benefits: An additional Rs 6,000 per year, matching the PM-KISAN amount, for a total of Rs 12,000 annually.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Maharashtra, additional income support, PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PM-KISAN registration, Bank account details

schemes.description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA) scheme for farmers in Odisha.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per family per year for small/marginal farmers and Rs. 12,500 for landless agricultural laborers.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Odisha, income support, landless laborers, marginal farmers.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details

schemes.description: Agriculture Investment Support Scheme by the Government of Telangana.
schemes.benefits: Investment support of Rs 5,000 per acre per season for two crops a year.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Telangana, investment support, per acre subsidy.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Pattadar Passbook, Bank account details

schemes.description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganized workers, including landless agricultural laborers.
schemes.benefits: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000/- after attaining the age of 60 years.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Pension, landless laborer, unorganized sector, monthly income limit.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details

schemes.description: Housing scheme to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly areas.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Housing, rural development, landless.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Job Card

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to a rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year at statutory minimum wage.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Wage employment, rural, landless.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Photograph

schemes.description: Jharkhand state pension scheme for farmers providing monthly financial support to elderly farmers.
schemes.benefits: A monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 is provided to eligible farmers above 60 years of age.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Pension, elderly farmers, Jharkhand.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Age proof, Land records, Bank account details

schemes.description: Gujarat state scheme allowing farmers to generate electricity using solar panels on their farms.
schemes.benefits: Farmers receive a 60% subsidy on the cost of the solar project.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Solar power, irrigation, electricity generation, Gujarat.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership document, Bank passbook, Electricity connection details

schemes.description: Jharkhand state scheme for Kharif crop cultivation providing financial assistance.
schemes.benefits: Rs 5,000 per acre per year, up to a maximum of 5 acres.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Kharif, investment support, Jharkhand.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details

schemes.description: Andhra Pradesh state scheme integrated with PM-KISAN providing financial assistance to farmer families.
schemes.benefits: Total financial assistance of Rs. 13,500 per farmer family per year.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Income support, tenant farmers, Andhra Pradesh.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Webland data, Bank account, Crop Cultivator Rights Card

schemes.description: Madhya Pradesh state scheme to compensate farmers for the difference between the minimum support price (MSP) and the market price.
schemes.benefits: Direct compensation to farmers' bank accounts if they sell their produce below the MSP.
schemes.crop: Soybean, Maize, Urad, Moong, Arhar, Groundnut, Sesame, Ramtil
schemes.eligibility_keywords: MSP, price deficit financing, Madhya Pradesh.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Registration at mandi

schemes.description: Central scheme to promote organic farming and reduce reliance on chemical fertilizers.
schemes.benefits: Rs 50,000 per hectare for 3 years, out of which Rs 31,000 is provided directly to farmers through DBT for inputs.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Organic farming, cluster approach, sustainable agriculture.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.description: Scheme for setting up standalone solar pumps and solarizing existing grid-connected agricultural pumps.
schemes.benefits: Up to 60% subsidy on standalone solar pumps; remaining 30% through bank loan and 10% farmer contribution.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Solar pumps, renewable energy, irrigation.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details, ID Proof

schemes.description: Scheme to ensure holistic development of agriculture and allied sectors by allowing states to choose their own agriculture and allied sector development activities.
schemes.benefits: Various subsidies on infrastructure, post-harvest assets, and agri-entrepreneurship projects.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Agri-infrastructure, state-led development, value chain.
schemes.required_documents: Varies by state and sub-scheme

schemes.description: Madhya Pradesh state scheme providing additional financial support to PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
schemes.benefits: An additional Rs 6,000 per year, matching the PM-KISAN amount, for a total of Rs 12,000 annually.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Madhya Pradesh, additional income support, PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PM-KISAN registration, Bank account details

schemes.description: West Bengal state scheme providing assured income and death benefit to farmers.
schemes.benefits: Up to Rs. 10,000 per year per acre. Death benefit of Rs. 2 lakh for farmers aged 18-60.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: West Bengal, income support, death benefit.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record (RoR), Bank account details, Voter ID

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Yantra Subsidy Yojana
schemes.description: Uttar Pradesh state scheme providing subsidies on agricultural machinery and implements.
schemes.benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on the purchase of approved agricultural machinery.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Uttar Pradesh, mechanization, farm machinery, subsidy.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details, Quotation of machinery

schemes.description: Gujarat state scheme providing financial assistance to farmers who suffered crop loss due to natural calamities.
schemes.benefits: Assistance up to Rs. 25,000 per hectare for crop loss exceeding 33%.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Gujarat, crop damage, disaster relief.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Land record, Bank account details, Crop loss proof

schemes.description: Scheme to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for aquaculture, fishing vessels, and post-harvest infrastructure. Subsidy typically 40% (60% for SC/ST/Women).
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Fisheries, aquaculture, fish farmers.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Detailed Project Report

schemes.description: Scheme focusing on entrepreneurship development and breed improvement in poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery.
schemes.benefits: 50% capital subsidy (up to Rs. 50 lakh) for setting up rural poultry farms, sheep/goat farms, and pig farms.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Livestock, poultry, goat farming, entrepreneurship.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Detailed Project Report, Land document (for farm setup)

schemes.description: Scheme to support villages in effectively managing their cattle and biodegradable waste.
schemes.benefits: Financial assistance for setting up biogas plants at individual or community level.
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Biogas, organic waste, rural sanitation, cattle dung.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Gram Panchayat resolution (for community plants)

schemes.description: Haryana state scheme providing working capital loans to livestock farmers, similar to the standard Kisan Credit Card.
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free loan up to Rs. 1.6 lakh for livestock rearing, at 4% interest rate (after subvention).
schemes.eligibility_keywords: Haryana, livestock loan, dairy, poultry.
schemes.required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank account details, Proof of livestock ownership
